correctness.rationale: Exact projector decomposition of the star Laplacian gives all entries as rational expressions. Positive off-diagonals leave hub Q_m and leaf P_m diagonal signs. The hub discriminant is positive exactly for integer m>=11; for m<=10, positivity follows by concavity in m for h>3 together with positive endpoint P2 and exact positive SOS P10, and by direct positivity for h<=3. For m>=11, P_m(8)<0, its leading/constant terms are positive and exactly two sign changes force exactly two simple positive roots. Ordering, endpoint inclusion and asymptotics follow. The verified local check program independently confirms four formal bivariate identities, an exact univariate SOS identity and 2046 exact-rational matrix assertions, output VERIFY_OK 2228. Finite tests are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Exact nonnegative-step sets are a safety constraint for positive heat diffusion beyond spectral/A-stability. The sharp m=11 threshold and TWO separated nonpositive-time gaps with three restoration windows give a natural complete classification. Both hub and leaf failures are identified by explicit polynomial criteria and have distinct asymptotic scales, providing usable numerical-step rules and showing nonmonotonic step-size safety.
